chars.JAMAL: JAMAL: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogger pants and white sneakers.
chars.KHALID: KHALID: a young man wearing a shiny black leather jacket over a red polo shirt, a thick gold chain, light-blue jeans and sunglasses pushed up on his head.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a thin, tired old man wearing a cream-white djellaba and a white knitted skullcap.
chars.COPS: COPS: plain-clothes policemen wearing dark grey windbreakers, black baseball caps and dark jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a simple Moroccan bedroom in Tangier in the afternoon, KHALID stands by the bed pulling JAMAL by the arm, grinning and insisting, while JAMAL, half lying on the bed with a phone in his hand, frowns and resists. Open tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow Tangier street in front of a blue-doored house, KHALID leans on a shiny black Mercedes, mocking with a teasing gesture, while JAMAL stands at the doorstep in slippers looking offended.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same Tangier street next to the black Mercedes: JAMAL points back at his house and argues, shaking his head, while KHALID spreads his arms with a sly smile, refusing to explain.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan living room with low sofas and patterned cushions, JAMAL, dressed to go out, bends down and kisses the forehead of his sick FATHER who sits on the sofa with a blanket on his knees, looking at him with worry.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the black Mercedes driving on a Moroccan highway at sunset, KHALID at the steering wheel and JAMAL in the passenger seat, both laughing loudly, music playing, dry hills outside.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At a roadside Moroccan cafe terrace with plastic chairs at dusk, KHALID and JAMAL sit at a small table drinking mint tea from glasses, the black Mercedes parked behind them, relaxed.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At dusk beside the roadside cafe, six COPS suddenly rush out from a white van and surround the black Mercedes, shouting and grabbing; KHALID and JAMAL jump up from their chairs in shock, a tea glass falling.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Next to the black Mercedes at night, KHALID panics, twisting and trying to run away, while two COPS grab him by the arms and the jacket; dramatic struggle.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Next to the black Mercedes at night under a street lamp, JAMAL stands perfectly still with both hands raised, wide-eyed and confused, facing a COP who points at him; other cops in the blurred background.
